data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 proposes that the algebraic substitution can be abstracted as a causal mechanism (market-clearing condition and supply-side pricing rule) to make other artifacts compatible. However, this proposal is internally incoherent: if the school stance requires an empirically grounded pricing model, then the abstraction fails by its own stated refutation condition, meaning the proposed integration does not hold. The relation is merely a summary of how artifacts could align under a hypothetical, not a substantive established relation.
